name: partition around a pivot and recurse
mechanism: choose a pivot, rearrange the sequence so everything smaller precedes everything larger, then sort the two sides independently

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Quicksort' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Sequence sorting: divide list into two, with all items on the first list coming before all items on the second list.; then sort the two lists. Often the method of choice
